initialization: fresh seed42 random weights; no old formal or diagnostic checkpoint initialization

training.sampling_scope: one forced-positive union and one 32K complement draw per logical batch
training.projection_dropout_scope: one candidate projection draw shared by all microbatches in a logical batch
training.update_scope: prefix-weighted micro losses; one clip, scaler, optimizer and scheduler step per logical batch
training.schedule_scope: borrowed one-pass schedule for resource probes only; formal training is not authorized
training.amp: FP16 input/SID path with GradScaler; dense loss FP32, TF32 disabled

validation.catalog_partition: two balanced contiguous sorted-row shards, one per GPU
validation.purpose: complete catalog and state-preserving integration only, not recommendation quality

benchmark.replay: repeat the first 32 of the 65 validation records with fixed model weights
benchmark.timing_scope: generation plus complete cold ranking; input packing, projection cache preparation and unique-record audit reported separately
benchmark.interpretation: repeated-input latency probe, not independent samples or additional validation metrics
